DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP).

The combination of pseudobulbar palsy (difficulty swallowing), parkinsonian features (involuntary movements), and a history of substance use with a misdiagnosis of Multiple Sclerosis strongly suggests this neurodegenerative disorder. I have already ordered the necessary MRI scans to confirm the characteristic "hummingbird" sign on mid-sagittal views.
